description: This Java class defines a service called BookExportService that exports book data for a specific user by retrieving all books associated with that user from the BookRepository and returning an ExportDto containing the list.

classes.name: BookExportService
classes.description: A service class responsible for exporting book data for a user.

methods.name: exportBooksData
methods.description: Retrieves all books for a given user and returns an ExportDto containing the list.
